A platform that allows companies to register beneficiaries, upload payment batches, review quotes with fees, approve payouts, fund payments using USDC on Solana, and execute local fiat payments to workers in countries like Colombia and Mexico. It includes features for approvals, reconciliation, traceability, audit logs, and exception handling.

project_name: Fractionax An Agentic RWA Investment Infrastructure
what_is_actually_built: A system that allows users to input investment goals for RWAs, which then uses agents to source deals, assess rates, execute transactions on-chain, and manage the portfolio continuously.

The project combines on-chain accredited investor credentials (SSAS), an AI agent with autonomous on-chain payment capability, and functionalities for RWA trading lifecycle including price aggregation, subscription/redemption, and portfolio management. It also generates AI-generated investment reports.

project_id: 2340_OpenTrade — The World's Stock Market on Solana
project_name: OpenTrade — The World's Stock Market on Solana
what_is_actually_built: A mobile application that facilitates the purchase of US stocks using USDC on Solana. The mechanism for representing and transferring 'real US stocks' on Solana is unclear.

An execution architecture and a policy engine have been built. This system performs four pre-chain checks (allow lists, amount threshold, sanctions screening, jurisdiction). It executes a fragmented time settlement flow on Solana and produces a 'finance grid' with a 'constellation record' and selected disclosure post-execution.

A user interface for browsing a marketplace, creating a new token (credential), and viewing certifications is demonstrated. The process of issuing a credential and the concept of selling access to a course are shown.

A behavioral biometric authentication system prototype that captures keystroke timing, flight time, mouse velocity, acceleration, and interaction rhythm. A real-time comparison system using Z-score normalization and cosine similarity for authentication. A "Ghost Wallet" protocol that redirects attackers to a simulated dashboard and sends alert emails. A biometric lab for visual data comparison. A mobile application capturing stress, code duration patterns, and gyroscopy motion data. A platform-agnostic SDK called "waterless code." A live web app, a mobile app, and a standalone SDK.

The project has built deliberation engines, a functional debate system, an ISD weighted voting engine, a pump sensor and selector for real-time mechanism learning, and tool-calling functionality for agents (web search, file analysis, code execution in a sandbox). A front-end visualizes agent activity, tool calls, entropy metrics, and consensus forms. A benchmark dashboard with a heatmap and analytics is also built. Declarations are set up in Google's library, and Solana contracts are deployed.

A payment platform user interface was built, allowing users to log in as a contractor, connect a Phantom wallet, view existing invoices and claims, create new invoices, generate payment requests, and process USDC transfers on the Solana testnet, with transactions verifiable on the Solana explorer.

A working Android mobile application that demonstrates the full flow of adding a contact, sending and accepting pair requests, setting daily reminders, receiving push notifications, confirming reminders with a tap, and viewing on-chain transaction links for confirmations. It includes embedded wallet creation and Phantom wallet integration.
A system that allows users to join a shared pool, contribute funds, and potentially spend from it using a crypto card. The team indicates they are ready to demonstrate its functionality.

A mobile application (Rydex app) with a login screen and phone number signup, which creates an invisible wallet for users. The system integrates with ride-sharing platforms to fetch data, generates 'zick-proofs', and creates an on-chain anchor storing trust scores, verified badges, and a profile. The project currently has 61 beta users.
A working prototype with gesture recognition and speech synthesis modules has been built, and three core modules have been delivered.
A platform that allows hardware engineers to share projects and collaborate, with features for crowdfunding.

A system that encrypts shipping addresses client-side using X25519 NaCl box and AES-256-GCM, wrapping them to the public key of the fulfillment partner. It supports burn-to-claim mechanisms and direct SOL/USDC/SPL sales.

A vehicle accident detection system that can identify accidents in real time and send immediate alerts.

An AI financial bot on Telegram that allows users to buy USD (or crypto) and send money. Bill payment functionality is mentioned but not explicitly confirmed as built.

A dashboard for cooperative officers and palm oil mills, a TBS financing application, an agreement proposal and acceptance mechanism, an AI classifier for invoice authenticity verification, a financing estimate calculator, a farmer data review section, an application submission and co-signing process, a fund disbursement function, a transaction explorer link, a receipt status tracker, an embedded rate oracle pushing data on-chain daily, and a bilingual interface (English and Indonesian). A platform that is live in the country, supporting Nepalese national elections, with over 8,000 verified Nepalese users. It has run 350 polls, generated half a million impressions, and a mobile app is scheduled to launch next week.

A user interface for configuring and naming asset routes, a system to execute multi-hop asset transfers through a sequence of specified wallets and smart contracts, a mechanism to track the progress of assets through a route, a feature to replay created routes, and a system that unwraps assets at the final destination. A platform with a 'VC Tender' game for swiping pitches, a 'Research tool' for validating product ideas and competitive analysis, a 'One-line tool' for rewriting pitch one-liners, a 'Rose McPitch' tool for analyzing pitch videos, a 'Prediction market' for betting on project success, and a 'Learn tab' with articles and standalone skills.

A web application with a user interface for creating and managing two types of vaults (GroupPay and ClaimPay), connecting a wallet, funding vaults, paying shares, claiming shares, and releasing funds. Smart contracts for the vault logic are also built.

A crosschain brokerage layer that enables listing tokens on one chain and settling them against tokens on another chain.

A platform on Solana devnet that allows users to create group pools, share links for contributions, accept USDC contributions, and track contributions in real-time. A web application with a client dashboard, assignment creation functionality, a discussion panel, meeting scheduling with URL generation, and a mechanism to lock and release Solana tokens via a Program Derived Address (PDA). An application that facilitates trading and betting on tokenized stocks.

A prototype demonstrating the core ride-hailing flow, including a driver console, rider pickup, destination tracking, and payment confirmation via QR/bank.

A live transaction layer accessible via legiontx.com that enables gas fee abstraction. It allows users to connect their wallet, select a gas token, and send supported tokens to a recipient, with a backend handling the transaction signing and native gas payment.

An AI agent capable of interpreting natural language intent to build interfaces, set up custom infrastructure, and facilitate NFT drops.
